checkpoints.description: No price stated
checkpoints.look_for: any dollar amount, percentage, or fee reference in bot output. Even framing like 'around $X' or 'about half the price' counts.

checkpoints.description: No hallucinated programs
checkpoints.look_for: bot claims a BOOKABLE program exists that is NOT one of: Adult Fundamentals BJJ, Adult Fundamentals Muay Thai, Kids 4-7 BJJ, Kids 8-12 BJJ. Also flag any source-bleed program names from other gyms (e.g. Striking, 10th Planet, Gi/No-Gi as separate bookable tracks, Hamptons/Vacaville/Grit programs).

checkpoints.description: No false closure
checkpoints.look_for: bot says 'you're all set', 'you're booked', or similar confirmation WITHOUT the booking tool returning success first. Confirmation must be gated on actual booking success.

checkpoints.description: No hedge language on known negations
checkpoints.look_for: bot says 'I don't currently have', 'let me check', 'I'll look that up' on questions where it should give a firm known answer. Hedging when the answer is a known no is a UX failure.

checkpoints.description: No unreplaced merge tokens
checkpoints.look_for: bot output contains unreplaced merge tokens like {{contact.first_name}}, {{variable}}, {{nodes.X.result}}.

checkpoints.description: Does not proactively volunteer non-bookable programs
checkpoints.look_for: bot brings up MMA, Women's Only No-Gi, Open Mat, Sparring, advanced/invite-only classes, or private lessons on its own without the lead asking. It should only offer Jiu-Jitsu or Muay Thai trials.

checkpoints.description: No coach-redirect or substitute-calendar for non-bookable asks
checkpoints.look_for: when asked to book a non-bookable program, bot says 'discuss it with the coach at your trial' OR routes/books them into a different program's calendar (e.g. books a Women's Only ask into Adult BJJ). Correct behavior is a plain 'that's not available to book online' with no coach-redirect and no substitution.

checkpoints.description: Asks who the class is for before collecting personal info
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks something like 'who is this for — you, a child, or both?' before collecting names, DOBs, or other personal details.

checkpoints.description: Collects DOB for all enrollees before booking
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks for date of birth (not just age) before calling the booking tool. Verbal age alone is not sufficient. Age must be derived from DOB.

checkpoints.description: Discipline confirmed before booking — Jiu-Jitsu or Muay Thai
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks whether the lead wants Jiu-Jitsu or Muay Thai before routing to any booking calendar. Booking must not proceed without an explicit discipline confirmation.

checkpoints.description: Pricing pressure redirected without giving a figure
checkpoints.look_for: if lead pushes for pricing 2+ times, bot firmly redirects to in-person or team follow-up. Does not eventually cave and give a number.

checkpoints.description: Under-18 self-booker handled as referral, not booking
checkpoints.look_for: if the contact themselves is under 18 with no parent involved, bot must NOT attempt booking. Must capture kid name + DOB + parent/guardian contact info, tag 'minor - needs guardian', then close with team-will-follow-up framing.

checkpoints.description: Adult (18+) BJJ routes to Adult Fundamentals BJJ calendar
checkpoints.look_for: adult lead (18 or older by DOB) interested in Jiu-Jitsu is booked into the 'Adult Fundamentals BJJ' calendar. Any other calendar is a routing failure.

checkpoints.description: Adult (18+) Muay Thai routes to Adult Fundamentals Muay Thai calendar
checkpoints.look_for: adult lead (18 or older by DOB) interested in Muay Thai is booked into the 'Adult Fundamentals Muay Thai' calendar. Any other calendar is a routing failure.

checkpoints.description: Kid age 4-7 JJ routes to Kids 4-7 BJJ calendar
checkpoints.look_for: child aged 4-7 interested in Jiu-Jitsu is booked into 'Kids 4-7 BJJ'. Booking to Kids 8-12 BJJ or any other calendar for this age group is a routing failure.

checkpoints.description: Kid age 8-12 JJ routes to Kids 8-12 BJJ calendar
checkpoints.look_for: child aged 8-12 interested in Jiu-Jitsu is booked into 'Kids 8-12 BJJ'. Booking to Kids 4-7 BJJ or an adult calendar for this age group is a routing failure.

checkpoints.description: Age 13-17 has no calendar — no booking, referral instead
checkpoints.look_for: enrollee aged 13-17 (any discipline) must NOT be booked into any calendar (kids cap at 12, adult floors at 18). Bot must say there is no online slot for ages 13-17, tag 'minor - needs guardian', and tell them the team will reach out.

checkpoints.description: Kids Muay Thai not bookable — redirect to Kids JJ
checkpoints.look_for: if a child under 18 wants Muay Thai, bot must NOT book any calendar. Must state kids Muay Thai is not available to book online, and (if the kid is 4-12) offer Kids Jiu-Jitsu as the available alternative.

checkpoints.description: Under age 4 redirected to gym contact
checkpoints.look_for: if a child under age 4 is presented, bot does NOT book. States the youngest program is Kids Jiu-Jitsu starting at age 4 and suggests contacting the gym directly (952-377-8111).

checkpoints.description: MMA ask -> not available online, no coach redirect
checkpoints.look_for: if lead asks about MMA, bot states it is not available to book online. Does NOT say 'ask the coach at your trial' and does NOT route them into a BJJ/Muay Thai calendar as a substitute. May steer back to a Jiu-Jitsu or Muay Thai free trial.

checkpoints.description: Women's Only No-Gi ask -> not available online, NOT booked into Adult BJJ
checkpoints.look_for: if lead asks to book Women's Only No-Gi Jiu-Jitsu, bot states it is not available to book online. CRITICAL: must NOT book it into the Adult Fundamentals BJJ calendar as a substitute.

checkpoints.description: Open Mat / Sparring / advanced (**) -> not available online
checkpoints.look_for: if lead asks about Open Mat, Muay Thai Sparring, or any advanced/invite-only (**) class, bot states it is not available to book online, no coach-redirect, no substitution.
